scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the remote courtroom-relay final practicum usable for certificate credit by satisfying the equipment-clearance prerequisite before the roster freezes.
Emerging Need: A required headset compatibility clearance is absent, but it matters only after Amara’s final placement resolves into a remote section that reads the recorded clearance status.
Decision Context: The stored requirement and saved lab rules establish the pending prerequisite, authorized desk, disclosure limits, and no-fee booking route; live notices determine whether a same-day slot can still attach to the roster.
Consequence: Timely clearance preserves participation in the future practicum, while missed lab timing leaves only non-credit observation access.

parameter.subject: Final practicum format still under review
parameter.body: The certificate office is still deciding whether the June final practicum will run in person or by remote courtroom-relay simulation. Section placements and any technology roster steps will post only after the city bandwidth review is complete. Please continue ordinary terminology review for now; the individual tech-check roster is not open today.

parameter.title: Certificate final practicum placement hold
parameter.description: Final practicum window for assigned delivery mode; placement details pending from certificate office.

parameter.name: Remote Interpreting Lab Desk
parameter.organization: City Adult School Language Technology Lab
parameter.notes: Verified student-services contact for remote practicum equipment checks.

parameter.subject: Remote practicum placement notice - Section R-3
parameter.body: Your June 20 final practicum placement is Section R-3, the remote courtroom-relay simulation, scheduled for 6:30 p.m. The roster lock for prerequisite clearances begins Friday, June 19 at 4:00 p.m. The roster will read the existing headset-clearance requirement record; remote placements without an attached clearance will be routed to non-credit observation seating only.

parameter.content: R-3 certified headset-check openings today are 12:15 p.m. and 3:30 p.m. Same-day sheet entries can be made from messages received before 10:45 a.m.; include the practicum code, student name, and the clearance requirement reference. The check itself takes about 20 minutes in Lab 2B.

parameter.subject: R-3 headset check sheet closed
parameter.body: The final certified headset-check slot for Section R-3 has begun, and the walk-up sheet is closed. Because overnight QA must run after a completed live check, no additional headset clearances can post before the June 19 4:00 p.m. roster lock for this practicum.
